summary.text: The key Auth...1111 can replace this strategy's code at any time.
When you trade through Pipeline, the router refuses a swap that would pay you less than your minimum.

claims.text: The key Auth...1111 can replace the program's code at any time, for every market at once.
Besides Pipeline's six instructions, the program has one more, called Deposit.
On 2026-11-09, a buy of 0.00001 SOL sold straight back returned 99.39% of the input.
Deposit is signed directly on the strategy, so the router does not protect it.
